concept.title: Upgrading a QuayRegistry resource
concept.shortdesc: The Red Hat Quay Operator reconciles QuayRegistry resources and upgrades them when the Operator version differs from the current version. When an upgrade is supported, the Operator applies it and updates status; when not, it returns an error and leaves the QuayRegistry unchanged.

ul.li: If status.currentVersion is unset, reconcile as normal.
If status.currentVersion equals the Operator version, reconcile as normal.

If status.currentVersion does not equal the Operator version, check if it can be upgraded. If it can, perform upgrade tasks and set the status.currentVersion to the Operator’s version once complete. If it cannot be upgraded, return an error and leave the QuayRegistry and its deployed Kubernetes objects alone.
